name: proto-lab
install:
set -e
. "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"
NODE_SPEC="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
if ! NVM_NO_COLORS=1 nvm ls "$NODE_SPEC" 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'v[0-9]'; then
  nvm install "$NODE_SPEC"
fi
nvm alias default "$NODE_SPEC"
nvm use "$NODE_SPEC"
NODE_VER="$(nvm version "$NODE_SPEC")"
PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/${NODE_VER}/bin:$PATH"
hash -r
node -e 'const s=process.versions.node,w=process.argv[1]; if(!(s===w||s.startsWith(w+"."))) process.exit(1)' "$NODE_SPEC"
sudo ln -sfn "$(command -v node)" /usr/local/bin/node
sudo ln -sfn "$(command -v npm)" /usr/local/bin/npm
sudo ln -sfn "$(command -v npx)" /usr/local/bin/npx
tmp="$(mktemp)"
awk '
  $0 == "# proto-lab-node-begin" { skip = 1; next }
  $0 == "# proto-lab-node-end" { skip = 0; next }
  skip != 1 { print }
' "$HOME/.bashrc" > "$tmp"
cat >> "$tmp" << 'BLOCK'
# proto-lab-node-begin
# El Node del alias default de nvm queda delante de otros node de la imagen.
if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/alias/default" ]; then
  _proto_lab_spec=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$HOME/.nvm/alias/default")
  if [ -n "$_proto_lab_spec" ]; then
    _proto_lab_node=$(find "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "v${_proto_lab_spec}*" -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)
    if [ -n "$_proto_lab_node" ] && [ -x "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/${_proto_lab_node}/bin/node" ]; then
      PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/${_proto_lab_node}/bin:$PATH"
    fi
  fi
  unset _proto_lab_spec _proto_lab_node
  hash -r
fi
# proto-lab-node-end
BLOCK
mv "$tmp" "$HOME/.bashrc"
npm install -g corepack && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@12.17.0 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
